work_items: Consolidate runtime telemetry, development economics, and bounded retention around Wave 4 run-event plane, Wave 6 durable runtime evidence, W7-S1 evaluation outcomes, and W7-S2 known-state projection semantics.
validations: Consistent with Wave 4 run-event plane, Wave 6 durable runtime evidence, W7-S1 evaluation outcomes, and W7-S2 known-state projection semantics.
AC-01: validate protected requirement — Every metric/summary derives only from documented server-owned Project/run/event/worker/evaluation/provider evidence and preserves exact canonical binding.
AC-02: validate protected requirement — Observed, estimated and unknown states are explicit; unknown never becomes zero and estimated never masquerades as observed.
AC-03: validate protected requirement — Every known value includes bounded provenance/derivation identity sufficient to audit how it was produced without exposing private raw payloads.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Protected deterministic failure remains authoritative in quality summaries/trends and cannot be overridden by positive qualitative evaluation or Preview status.
AC-05: validate protected requirement — Duplicate/replayed event evidence does not double-count time, usage, retry, recovery, intervention or quality results; exact re-projection is deterministic.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — History windows, rows, metric names and dimensions are server bounded; arbitrary high-cardinality user/model/repository strings cannot become telemetry dimensions.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Cross-Project metric/history access fails closed except for an explicitly authorized aggregate-only server scope, and aggregate output exposes no private per-Project payload.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Retention cleanup can affect only S5-owned derived telemetry in permitted retention classes and cannot delete/mutate Projects, Work Specifications, Engineering Runs, source lineage, protected attempts, delivery or release evidence.
AC-09: validate protected requirement — Repeated cleanup is safe/idempotent, produces bounded audit evidence and cannot mutate canonical runtime state when cleanup fails.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — No credentials, cookies/auth headers, server environment, raw provider payloads, prompts, hidden reasoning, source bytes/patches, unrestricted logs or raw sensitive URLs are persisted or returned.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — S5 metric output can populate/extend W7-S2 known-state economic presentation without redefining S2 identity/control authority or requiring client-side metric inference.
AC-12: validate protected requirement — S5 grants no new lifecycle, source acceptance, provider/tool administration, arbitrary command/network, merge/deploy or REVIEW-completion authority.

AC-13: validate protected requirement — Before integration, S5 commits authentic DSPy evidence for `P2-V0.20.5`, reconciles to the latest accepted Wave 7 integration SHA, passes protected spec validation and applicable API/data/replay/privacy/cumulative gates, then stops `READY FOR INTEGRATION` for Control Tower expected-head merge.
risks: No material risk and mitigation identified.
